name: tc-coverage
displayName: TC Coverage — Change Impact & Test Cases
description: Shows the test cases, corner cases and impact flow a C++/CMake change must be checked against (powered by tcadvisor).

commands.title: Copy gtest filter of tests to re-run

tcCoverage.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter with tcadvisor installed (pip install -e <TCCoverage>). Empty = python on Windows, python3 elsewhere.

tcCoverage.repo.description: Analysed git repository root. Empty = first workspace folder.

tcCoverage.buildDir.description: CMake build dir (relative to repo or absolute) with compile_commands.json and .cmake/api/v1/reply. Empty = build_dir in the repository's .tcadvisor/config.json, else <repo>/build.

tcCoverage.outputDir.description: Report directory (must be outside the repo). Empty = output_dir in the repository's .tcadvisor/config.json, else <repo>/../tcadvisor-report/<repo-name>.

tcCoverage.targets.description: Comma-separated CMake targets to restrict the scope (e.g. RemoteDoorLock,RemoteDoorUnlock). Empty = targets in the repository's .tcadvisor/config.json, else all.

tcCoverage.maxHopDepth.markdownDescription: Caller levels to follow. Empty = `max_hop_depth` in the repository's `.tcadvisor/config.json`, else 2.

tcCoverage.showInlineHints.description: Show P1/P2 cases as hints on the evidence lines.

enumDescriptions: GitNexus (PolyForm-Noncommercial: enable only if your organisation allows it)
tcCoverage.graphProvider.markdownDescription: Where impact comes from. The chosen source is always used: if it is missing or fails, the run stops (a missing codegraph offers to install it). Empty = `graph` in the repository's `.tcadvisor/config.json`, else `codegraph`.

tcCoverage.reportLanguage.markdownDescription: Language of the report (Markdown, HTML, brief). Empty = `language` in the repository's `.tcadvisor/config.json`, else `vi`.

tcCoverage.graphBin.description: Path to the codegraph/gitnexus executable (empty = PATH).

tcCoverage.ai.approved.description: Allow sending packed code windows (≤40 lines per impacted symbol, never the repository) to Claude for verification. Machine-scoped: a repository's .vscode/settings.json cannot turn this on.

tcCoverage.ai.claudePath.description: Claude Code CLI used in headless mode.

tcCoverage.ai.verifyModel.description: Model for per-batch case verification (cheap, many calls).

tcCoverage.ai.synthModel.description: Model for the single synthesis call.

tcCoverage.ai.order.markdownDescription: Order of cases inside each priority group. `relevance` = deterministic order (default). `ai` = AI-triaged view: confirmed > needs_info > unverified > weak (pilot: fixed function in the top 10 for 29/55 regressions vs 26/55). AI never removes cases.
